name: Blackflight Resurgence raises Legacy of Deathwing's damage bonus (#1226)
contract: #1226: Blackflight Resurgence 805587 is ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (aura 107) on SPELLMOD_EFFECT3 (misc 23), base 49 -> +50 (Spell.dbc served file), class mask {0, 0x4000, 0} = Legacy of Deathwing 520823. 520823's DBC effect 3 is an ADD_PCT_MODIFIER on SPELLMOD_DAMAGE, base -1 -> 0%, mask {0x8000000, 0, 0x2000} = Destroyer's Maw and Firefall, so the talent lifts it to +50%. The module overwrote that slot with its free-cast COST -100% modifier, leaving -100 + 50 = -50 (Destroyer's Maw and Firefall cost half and gain no damage). The cost modifier now sits in effect 2, freed by zeroing the DBC custom effect. spell_modifier applies the player's native modifiers to a base of 1000: op 0 (DAMAGE) must read 1500 and op 14 (COST) must read 0 for both spells, with the aura re-applied after learning the talent so the effect amount is recomputed. Before the fix the damage reads 1000 and the cost 500.

steps.label: Legacy of Deathwing alone leaves Destroyer's Maw damage unchanged
Legacy of Deathwing alone makes Destroyer's Maw free
Legacy of Deathwing alone makes Firefall free
Blackflight Resurgence adds 50% to Destroyer's Maw damage
Blackflight Resurgence adds 50% to Firefall damage
Blackflight Resurgence leaves Destroyer's Maw free
